result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile warning pads, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway creates a significant unprotected crossing distance, and the presence of large parked vehicles near the corner may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and overhead traffic signals. However, the environment lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions, and parked vehicles near the crossing create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side of the image may block the line of sight between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The wide, undivided roadway leaves pedestrians exposed for the entire duration of the crossing without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane roadway lacking marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, creating a high-exposure environment. While sidewalks are present, they are partially obstructed by construction barriers and lack designated safe crossing points.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at a large, signalized intersection forces pedestrians to cross without clear right-of-way or visibility to drivers.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cover a long distance without any refuge, increasing exposure time to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction barriers and street furniture on the left sidewalk restrict pedestrian movement and may force people into the roadway.
